scope: Bounded construction-first Americas review closes one DataBank Red Oak campus proposal and preserves four specific holds. No central module, contract, draft artifact, old source, tests or commit changed.

successor_context.finding: No authoritative campus-completion or cancellation successor found in bounded official index and exact-campus searches. July26 says only DFW9 is expected online in August; remaining three first-phase buildings follow later staggered delivery. This forecast is not an actual completion event.
scope_caveats: First-phase scope is broader than the one locator building.
Current undated facility pages and September retrieval do not refresh lifecycle.
No eight-building or later-phase completion, capacity, workload or ownership claim is normalized.
The undated Yates DFW10 case study states a 2027 completion target; it is identity context only and does not date construction or a successor as of the cutoff.

proposals.rights_scope: No open licence or public-domain status is asserted for DataBank or Ellis County content. Only compact independently restated project facts and one isolated official address-point coordinate are proposed with attribution. The county copyright notice and blank GIS item licenseInfo are preserved; public access is not treated as an affirmative redistribution grant. No source prose, polygon, database, map code, brochure, photograph, logo or raw body is redistributed.

undated_constituent_identity.scope_caveat: This independently corroborates that DFW10 is a real DataBank construction project in Red Oak. Temporary dry-in and slab sequencing are not assigned to July 26 or otherwise normalized as in-window milestones. The 2027 target does not prove completion or establish an as-of-cutoff successor.

holds.finding: June 2 council-work-session cover date and page 7 state one data center under construction in council district 7. The slide does not name ACS, Coravel, Hicks Field, an address or a parcel. District count cannot safely supply exact identity.

context_only_sources.reading: Public TDLR record names HICKS FIELD DFW11 at 10200 Hicks Field Road, but registered status and planned start/completion dates are not actual work observations.
Previously captured primary July15 lease/campus release from Europe19 is future delivery and commercial identity, not a new actual-work statement.

holds.not_selected: The May31 DBJ search caption was not promoted to authoritative project work, and no paywall body was fetched. No coordinate proposed or full-geometry dedup claimed for this held candidate.
holds.next_decisive_evidence: A named current-work city permit/inspection or owner/contractor report explicitly tying the CD7 build to the exact Hicks Field campus.

holds.candidate: Energy Vault Snyder AI / Crusoe Spark campus
holds.finding: The openly returned web-reader primary release explicitly describes physical enabling work for deployment of the modular data-center platform, not merely unrelated generator construction. However no successful full raw body capture was obtained, and exact reusable campus locator remains unresolved.
holds.date_and_scope_caveat: Q1 2027 commercial operation and broader expansion capacities are forecasts. February technology-center agreement is identity/planning context, not in-window work. Existing completed battery/gravity facilities are not completed AI data centers.
